contract.intended_consumer: Brian monitoring one approved outcome across isolated Codex and Claude sessions
contract.outcome: Codex and Claude native task views reflect one canonical criterion-bound outcome without allowing native green state to close the canonical goal.

canonical_journey.starting_state: One disposable goal has two frozen criteria and two stable execution items projected into isolated Codex and Claude sessions.
canonical_journey.input: The accepted neutral projection, exact native adapter observations, and current criterion evidence.
canonical_journey.action: Complete both native task displays while withholding one criterion's evidence, then add valid evidence, rename and reorder items, hand off across clients, and replay one event.
canonical_journey.observable_result: The incomplete proposal is denied, the fully evidenced proposal succeeds once, and identity survives rename, reorder, handoff, and replay.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Native green state closes the goal, adapter failure mutates canonical state, or replay duplicates a transition.

success_criteria.description: The neutral execution projection and canonical completion proposal are accepted with both-sign evidence.
An isolated Codex session emits correlated native plan observations without canonical mutation authority.
An isolated Claude session emits correlated Task or hook observations without canonical mutation authority.
The public cross-client fixture denies native-green incomplete closure and accepts fully evidenced closure exactly once.

request.approval_text: Brian approved implementation of Plan 137 on 2026-09-12.
